description: Look up a Solana program instruction from instruction data, an Anchor discriminator, a native instruction tag, or an instruction name. Returns matching programs, account lists, argument types and page URLs from a bundled IDL snapshot. No RPC. Programs can upgrade; computed Anchor discriminators are labelled as computed. Free, no payment needed. Use when you have instruction data or a discriminator and need to know which instruction it is.

data.description: Instruction data (hex or base58), a discriminator (e.g. 0xe517cb977ae3ad2a), or an instruction name (e.g. route or SetComputeUnitLimit).

program_id.description: Optional program ID, slug or name to narrow matches (e.g. jupiter-v6 or JUP6LkbZbjS1jKKwapdHNy74zcZ3tLUZoi5QNyVTaV4).

name: lookup_solana_instruction
title: Solana instruction discriminator lookup (free)
